units.source_text: 我震惊的是这两人其后的愉快对话，谈及各类名僧之死的轶闻。

en.t: What shocked me was the cheerful conversation the two of them had afterward, in which they discussed all sorts of anecdotes about the deaths of famous monks.

units.source_text: 据说，有位名僧说了声"啊！我真想死"，就死去了。

en.t: It is said that one famous monk said, "Ah! I really want to die," and then died.

units.source_text: 有位名僧同歌德一样，说了声"给我更多的光明"，就死去了。

en.t: Another famous monk, like Goethe, said, "Give me more light," and then died.

units.source_text: 还有位名僧弥留之际，还在计算自己的寺庙的钱财。

en.t: Still another famous monk, even on his deathbed, was calculating the money belonging to his own temple.
